intro: Slovakia loves ice hockey and has produced champions in cycling and canoe slalom.

chapters.title: Ice hockey and football
text: Slovakia won the ice hockey world championship in 2002. Its football team reached the last 16 at the 2010 World Cup after beating the reigning champions, Italy.

chapters.title: Cycling and canoeing
text: Peter Sagan won three road cycling world championships in a row from 2015 to 2017 and a record seven green jerseys at the Tour de France. Slovak paddlers are among the best in canoe slalom, winning several Olympic golds.
